name: answer-paper-correction
description: OCR-based handwritten answer-paper correction system (React + Node/Express gateway + Python OCR/grading service)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server,ocr -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run client" "npm run server" "npm run ocr"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../ocr-service && pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-gpu.txt
scripts.test: cd server && npm test && cd ../ocr-service && pytest
